harbor_antrieb_executor.summary: Built a site-to-site WireGuard tunnel between node1 and node2 over their transit network, routing node3's private lan-a (192.168.10.0/24) and node4's private lan-b (192.168.20.0/24) across it. node3 and node4 now reach each other by private address, and packet captures confirm the transit link carries only encrypted WireGuard UDP (port 51820), no plaintext ICMP visible. All four nodes were then restarted one at a time (preserving connectivity throughout) and verified to come back with new boot identities and fully recovered tunnel/routing state.
actions_performed: Mapped physical topology via ARP capture with tcpdump: node1 eth1<->node2 eth1 (transit), node1 eth2<->node3 enp8s0 (lan-a), node2 eth2<->node4 enp8s0 (lan-b)
Configured UCI static addressing on node1/node2 for transit (10.10.0.0/30) and lan-a/lan-b (192.168.10.0/24, 192.168.20.0/24) interfaces
Installed wireguard-tools/kmod-wireguard on node1 and node2, generated keypairs on-node, configured wg0 (10.99.0.0/30) with route_allowed_ips covering the peer's private LAN
Added firewall zones (lana/lanb, wg, transit) and forwarding rules on node1/node2 to route only lan<->wg traffic, plus a rule allowing inbound WireGuard UDP 51820 on the transit interface
Configured NetworkManager static IPs and explicit routes (not a second default route) on node3 and node4 pointing cross-LAN traffic at their local router via enp8s0
Verified bidirectional ping between node3 (192.168.10.10) and node4 (192.168.20.10), and captured transit-link traffic proving only encrypted WireGuard UDP crosses the shared network

Captured pre-restart boot_id/health baseline on all 4 nodes, restarted each one at a time via native reboot mechanisms, polled until exec access returned, and confirmed changed boot_id plus full recovery of interfaces, WireGuard handshake, routes, and cross-LAN ping on each node before proceeding to the next

evidence.requirement: Determine which physical NICs form lan-a, lan-b, and transit networks
evidence.summary: ARP captures via tcpdump proved node1 eth2<->node3, node1 eth1<->node2 eth1, and node2 eth2<->node4 are the actual L2-connected pairs

evidence.requirement: Encrypted tunnel established between node1 and node2 over transit network
evidence.summary: WireGuard wg0 interfaces configured with peer public keys/endpoints on both routers; wg show confirms active handshake and data transfer on both ends

evidence.requirement: Firewall permits only lan<->wg forwarding and WireGuard UDP on transit, not raw lan-to-lan
evidence.summary: UCI firewall zones/forwardings for lana/lanb/wg plus explicit Allow-WireGuard UDP 51820 rule committed on both routers

evidence.requirement: node3 and node4 reach each other by private addresses
evidence.summary: 0% packet loss pings from node3 (192.168.10.10) to node4 (192.168.20.10) and reverse direction

evidence.requirement: Traffic is encrypted in transit across the shared transit network
evidence.summary: tcpdump capture on node1 eth1 (transit) during active node3->node4 pings shows only WireGuard UDP port 51820 packets, no plaintext ICMP

evidence.requirement: node1 restart: healthy baseline, restart ack, changed boot identity, recovered state
evidence.summary: Baseline boot_id d140b4c4...; reboot acknowledged via connection close; post-reboot boot_id be82ab14... (changed, uptime 0); wg0/interfaces/tunnel handshake recovered; node3->node4 ping still succeeds

evidence.requirement: node2 restart: healthy baseline, restart ack, changed boot identity, recovered state
evidence.summary: Baseline boot_id 3a4844ba...; reboot acknowledged via connection close; post-reboot boot_id 43db9c26... (changed, uptime 0); wg0/interfaces/tunnel handshake recovered; node4->node3 ping still succeeds

evidence.requirement: node3 restart: healthy baseline, restart ack, changed boot identity, recovered state
evidence.summary: Baseline boot_id 98aa35f5...; systemctl reboot acknowledged via stream close; post-reboot boot_id d24fc976... (changed, uptime 0); enp8s0 address, routes, and ping to node4 all recovered

evidence.requirement: node4 restart: healthy baseline, restart ack, changed boot identity, recovered state
evidence.summary: Baseline boot_id fbdf5b2c...; systemctl reboot acknowledged via stream close; post-reboot boot_id e2ba69b1... (changed, uptime 0); enp8s0 address, routes, and ping to node3 all recovered
